## Changes made (source files only)

**The three specified files:**
- `lib/journal/src/entry.rs` — renamed the `CreatePipeV1` enum variant fields to `read_fd`/`write_fd`, and updated the `ArchivedJournalEntry → JournalEntry` conversion at line 621.
- `lib/journal/src/concrete/archived.rs` — renamed the `JournalEntryCreatePipeV1` serialization struct fields to `pub read_fd: u32` / `pub write_fd: u32`, and updated the serializer construction.
- `lib/journal/src/concrete/archived_from.rs` — updated the deserialization mapping to read `read_fd`/`write_fd` from the archived struct via `.to_native()`.

**Additional non-test source files that reference the fields (required for compilation):**
- `lib/journal/src/concrete/printing.rs` — display formatting.
- `lib/journal/src/concrete/auto_consistent.rs` — open-file tracking.
- `lib/journal/src/concrete/compacting.rs` — open-pipe tracking.
- `lib/wasix/src/syscalls/journal/play_event.rs` — replay/differ logic.
- `lib/wasix/src/journal/effector/syscalls/fd_pipe.rs` — `save_fd_pipe` maps its `fd1`/`fd2` params to `read_fd`/`write_fd` (read end → `read_fd`, write end → `write_fd`).
- `lib/cli/src/commands/journal/mount/fs.rs` — seed clipping.

(`filter.rs` uses `{ .. }` so needed no change.)

The only remaining `fd1`/`fd2` pipe references are in **test code** (`lib/journal/src/concrete/tests.rs` roundtrip test and the `#[cfg(test)]` module in `log_file.rs`), which I intentionally left untouched per the instruction — the verification system applies the test patches (renaming those to `read_fd`/`write_fd`) automatically. The `fd1`/`fd2` in `fd_pipe.rs` are local function parameter names, not enum fields, so they're correctly preserved.
